title: Data Analyst (human services)
text: Data Analyst (human services) at Ethos BeathChapman (Sydney, CBD, Inner West & Eastern Suburbs; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). Our client is a centrally located organisation with a focus to transform the way they deliver excellence and innovation. We have an exciting opportunity for a Data Analyst to join a large program of work currently in flight. The position is initially a 6 month rolling contract based in Ashfield. The role supports the Manager in projects to improve data capability, comprehension, and analysis across the organisation. The role holder will work on a variety of projects supporting Districts and Program areas to improve performance through techniques including targeted data analysis, development of performance measures, conducting workshops, and the development of specialised tools. To be successful in this role you must have a high level of data comprehension, skills in data analysis and strong skills in software to support data analysis and presentation. You must enjoy working within a diverse team, contributing to work on a variety of projects. This opportunity would also suit a data analyst, performance analyst, research analyst or reporting specialist with skills across the following:* Recent experience in data analysis and data interpretation - experience in a human services or related area would be well regarded Recent experience in use of data analysis software - such as SPSS, SAS, R or Stata Skills in the use of Microsoft Excel Experience in manipulating data for analysis or reporting purposes Experience in presenting data for use in reports or presentations Ability to interpret findings. This role is required to carry out analysis work within CGP Performance Analysis. Qualifications in data analytics, psychology, social science, health sciences, or equivalent experience would be highly regarded. For further information on this role or to confidentially apply, please contact Julie Cooper on 02 8227 9200 or apply directly via the Apply for this job button. Only WORD FORMAT resumes will be accepted.
